text: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High
Glory be to my Lord, the Most High, and praise be to Him, three times
Glory be to Him who has power and kingdom, pride and greatness
Glory be to the Holy One, Lord of the angels and the spirit

Oh God, I prostrated to You, and to You I believed, and to You I submitted. My face prostrated to the One who created it and formed it, and created its hearing and sight. Blessed be God, the best of creators.
Oh God, forgive me all my sins; Its subtlety and majesty, its beginning and its end, its openness and its secret

Oh God, put light in my heart, light in my tongue, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light beneath me, light above me, light on my right, light on my left, light in front of me, light behind me, light in my soul, and greater light for me.
